name: Cnergenz Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约事项；公告主要为季度业绩、股份分拆相关上市公告及股东大会文件。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比大幅增长，但公告未说明具体业务变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contract events for its business segments; announcements mainly comprised quarterly results, listing announcements related to share subdivision, and general meeting documents. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue grew significantly year-on-year, but the announcements did not specify any business changes.
